title: droost tool call, version 1
description: One line of a project's tool-call ledger, <state dir>/tool-calls.jsonl, where the state dir is droost/droost-workflow (or .droost-workflow on a project that still keeps its run there). Two writers append to it: the droost command's knowledge commands (Droost\Workflow\Knowledge\ToolCallLog) and the droost Drupal module's tools (Drupal\droost\Ledger\ToolCallLog), which links no workflow code and writes these same rows. Each row is one JSON object and a newline, appended under an exclusive lock. run and phase are read from <state dir>/run.json at the time (run_id, current_phase), NULL when no run is open. Arguments are never recorded: they carry content. Additive only within version 1.

tool.description: The tool or command id: droost_entity_create, code:wiki, …

outcome.description: fail includes a refusal: a disarmed gate, a denied permission, an undeclared input.

run.description: The run open when the call was made, or null.

phase.description: That run's current phase, or null.

detail.description: What the tool answered beyond the call, never its arguments. Optional; absent on most rows.
